Please delete this comment before you merge: the PR title and description become the squashed
commit, so only your own words should be left here.

Title: a Conventional Commit, `<type>(<scope>)!: <subject>`, e.g. `feat(core): classify prunable
trees`. It becomes the commit subject.

Description: what changed and why, in plain prose. Link the design doc and any issue.

Before you ask for review:
- One CL: one small, focused change.
- User-visible behavior has a spec scenario in `spec/cuj/`.
- Changes beyond a small fix include their design doc in `docs/design/<area>/`.
- `bazel test //...` passes.
- No attribution trailers anywhere; CI rejects them.

If AI helped, you're welcome to say so in a PR comment, not here.
